trans-unit.source: Select an interaction to view details
Invalid time format. Use hh:mm:ss or mm:ss
trans-unit.target: Vaqt formati noto‘g‘ri. hh:mm:ss yoki mm:ss formatidan foydalaning

trans-unit.source: No media has been added here yet.

trans-unit.target: Video yoki audio URL manzilini kiriting

trans-unit.source: Supported services: YouTube, Vimeo, TikTok, Spotify, direct video/audio links
trans-unit.target: Qo‘llab-quvvatlanadigan xizmatlar: YouTube, Vimeo, TikTok, Spotify va bevosita video/audio havolalari

trans-unit.source: YouTube videos only play on a web server
trans-unit.target: YouTube videolari faqat veb-serverda ijro etiladi

trans-unit.source: YouTube only plays embedded videos on pages that are served by a web server. This is a restriction imposed by YouTube, not by WebWriter.
trans-unit.target: YouTube o‘rnatilgan videolarni faqat veb-serverdan uzatiladigan sahifalarda ijro etadi. Bu WebWriter cheklovi emas, YouTube cheklovidir.

trans-unit.source: As a result, this video will not load in WebWriter's preview mode and in documents opened directly from a device. To let your students watch it, publish the document to a web server (e.g. WebWriter Cloud) and share the link from there.
trans-unit.target: Shu sababli bu video WebWriter oldindan ko‘rish rejimida yoki qurilmadan bevosita ochilgan hujjatlarda yuklanmaydi. O‘quvchilaringiz ko‘rishi uchun hujjatni veb-serverga (masalan, WebWriter Cloud) joylang va havolani ulashing.

trans-unit.source: If you want to distribute this document as a file rather than through a web server, use a different video source instead of YouTube.
trans-unit.target: Hujjatni veb-server orqali emas, fayl sifatida tarqatmoqchi bo‘lsangiz, YouTube o‘rniga boshqa video manbasidan foydalaning.

trans-unit.source: Videos from other sources and uploaded video or audio files aren't affected by this.
trans-unit.target: Boshqa manbalardagi videolar va yuklangan video yoki audio fayllarga bu ta’sir qilmaydi.

trans-unit.source: This file could not be read. Please try again or choose a different file.
trans-unit.target: Faylni o‘qib bo‘lmadi. Qayta urinib ko‘ring yoki boshqa faylni tanlang.

trans-unit.source: This file type isn't supported. Please choose an MP4 or WebM video, or an MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC or OGG audio file.
trans-unit.target: Bu fayl turi qo‘llab-quvvatlanmaydi. MP4 yoki WebM videosini, yoxud MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC yoki OGG audio faylini tanlang.

trans-unit.source: The media player could not be started. Please try again.
trans-unit.target: Media pleyerni ishga tushirib bo‘lmadi. Qayta urinib ko‘ring.

trans-unit.source: This file could not be loaded. It is damaged or isn't a video or audio file.
trans-unit.target: Faylni yuklab bo‘lmadi. U buzilgan yoki video/audio fayli emas.

trans-unit.source: Spotify albums and playlists aren't supported. Please use a link to a single track or episode.
trans-unit.target: Spotify albomlari va pleylistlari qo‘llab-quvvatlanmaydi. Bitta trek yoki epizod havolasidan foydalaning.

trans-unit.source: The media could not be loaded. The link may be broken or the file may no longer exist.
trans-unit.target: Mediani yuklab bo‘lmadi. Havola buzilgan yoki fayl endi mavjud bo‘lmasligi mumkin.

trans-unit.source: This link doesn't point to a video or audio file. Please check the link, or use a link to a supported service.
trans-unit.target: Bu havola video yoki audio faylga olib bormaydi. Havolani tekshiring yoki qo‘llab-quvvatlanadigan xizmat havolasidan foydalaning.

trans-unit.source: Loading the media was aborted. Please try again.
trans-unit.target: Media yuklanishi bekor qilindi. Qayta urinib ko‘ring.

trans-unit.source: The media could not be loaded because of a network error. Please check your internet connection, then try again.
trans-unit.target: Tarmoq xatosi sababli mediani yuklab bo‘lmadi. Internet ulanishingizni tekshirib, qayta urinib ko‘ring.

trans-unit.source: The media file is damaged or uses a format your browser cannot play.
trans-unit.target: Media fayli buzilgan yoki brauzeringiz ijro eta olmaydigan formatda.

trans-unit.source: The media could not be loaded. The link may be broken, or the format isn't supported by your browser.
trans-unit.target: Mediani yuklab bo‘lmadi. Havola buzilgan yoki brauzeringiz bu formatni qo‘llamasligi mumkin.

trans-unit.source: The media could not be loaded. Please check the link and your internet connection, then try again.
trans-unit.target: Mediani yuklab bo‘lmadi. Havola va internet ulanishingizni tekshirib, qayta urinib ko‘ring.

trans-unit.source: This YouTube link is invalid. Please check the link and try again.
trans-unit.target: Bu YouTube havolasi noto‘g‘ri. Tekshirib, qayta urinib ko‘ring.

trans-unit.source: This YouTube video doesn't exist or is private.
trans-unit.target: Bu YouTube videosi mavjud emas yoki maxfiy.

trans-unit.source: The owner of this YouTube video doesn't allow it to be embedded. Please use a different video.
trans-unit.target: Bu YouTube videosi egasi uni joylashtirishga ruxsat bermaydi. Boshqa videodan foydalaning.

trans-unit.source: YouTube refuses to play this video here because the page doesn't identify itself to YouTube. This happens in WebWriter's preview mode or in documents opened directly from your device. Publish this document to a web server (e.g. WebWriter Cloud) and open it from there.
trans-unit.target: YouTube bu videoni bu yerda ijro etmaydi, chunki sahifa o‘zini YouTube’ga tanishtirmaydi. Bu WebWriter oldindan ko‘rish rejimida yoki qurilmadan bevosita ochilgan hujjatlarda yuz beradi. Hujjatni veb-serverga (masalan, WebWriter Cloud) joylang va o‘sha yerdan oching.

trans-unit.source: The YouTube video could not be loaded. Please check the link and your internet connection, then try again.
trans-unit.target: YouTube videosini yuklab bo‘lmadi. Havola va internet ulanishingizni tekshirib, qayta urinib ko‘ring.

trans-unit.source: The Vimeo video could not be loaded. It may not exist, may be private, or may not allow being embedded.
trans-unit.target: Vimeo videosini yuklab bo‘lmadi. U mavjud bo‘lmasligi, maxfiy bo‘lishi yoki joylashtirishga ruxsat bermasligi mumkin.

trans-unit.source: The TikTok video could not be loaded. It may not exist, may be private, or may not allow being embedded.
trans-unit.target: TikTok videosini yuklab bo‘lmadi. U mavjud bo‘lmasligi, maxfiy bo‘lishi yoki joylashtirishga ruxsat bermasligi mumkin.

trans-unit.source: The Spotify track could not be loaded. It may not exist or may not be available in your region.
trans-unit.target: Spotify trekini yuklab bo‘lmadi. U mavjud emas yoki hududingizda ochilmasligi mumkin.

trans-unit.source: The media took too long to load. Please check the link and your internet connection, then try again.
trans-unit.target: Medianing yuklanishi juda uzoq davom etdi. Havola va internet ulanishingizni tekshirib, qayta urinib ko‘ring.

trans-unit.source: Are you sure you want to remove the current audio?
Are you sure you want to remove the current video?
Also remove all interactions and chapters
trans-unit.target: Barcha interaktivlik va boblarni ham olib tashlash

trans-unit.source: Remove the current media and keep its interactions and chapters?
trans-unit.target: Joriy mediani olib tashlab, interaktivlik va boblarni qoldirishni xohlaysizmi?
